title: L3-C03 membership-540 disposition -- the REQUIRED field on any clustering / materializer / fusion record
description: Mechanises the L3-C03 declaration at org/tier1_exec/1.0.0_SA_CTO/deliverables/D11_L3_WAVE1_BOUNDARY_DECLARATIONS_20260829.md @9c1a45ad28. The 540 LOAD-BEARING cross-domain memberships (PRD :391, of 2,383 multi-system members: 1,843 MECHANICAL same-domain + 540 spanning >1 domain) are a REQUIRED regression cohort. A record that cannot state the cohort's disposition does NOT report 'no change' -- the field is ABSENT and that REFUSES the record's membership claims.
